content.title: Is Walmart open on Easter?
content.text: Key PointsWalmart is open on Easter Sunday with regular store hours and reduced pharmacy hours.A meal deal for eight is available for $34.91, featuring holiday essentials.Easter items will be discounted 50-90% starting April 6, 2026. For many Americans, Walmart has become the go-to destination for seasonal items. The retailer’s massive footprint (it currently has upwards of 5,000 locations in the U.S.) and commitment to everyday low prices (Walmart items are 10-25% less than competitors, on average) make it one of the most accessible and affordable places to get those holiday goods. After all, in the midst of the hustle and bustle that typically surrounds a holiday like Easter, nothing is better than being able to pick up your honey-baked ham and basket stuffers all in the same place. Even better, Walmart is open on Easter Sunday. Whether you need to pop in to grab that potluck side dish you forgot, or grab a few dozen plastic eggs for the Easter bunny to find, the retailer has your back. Walmart’s Easter hours Most Walmart stores will be open normal hours on Easter 2026. The retailer plans to operate with regular hours, from 6 a.m to 11 p.m. However, some individual stores may close earlier than usual to accommodate employee scheduling. Walmart pharmacies will also be operating on reduced Sunday hours, open from just 10 a.m to 6 p.m. You can check the Easter Sunday hours of your preferred Walmart locations here. Walmart is open on Easter Sunday for shoppers’ last-minute needs.Shutterstock Walmart’s Easter deals If Easter snuck up on you this year, Walmart has the perfect solution for your holiday meal. The retailer is currently offering a limited-time meal deal for eight, priced at just $34.91. The package includes an entree, several sides, and ingredients for a seasonal dessert — everything you could need for a proper holiday feast. Items include: Marketside boneless spiral-cut brown sugar double glazed ham Fresh whole asparagus Fresh baby carrots Green Giant extra sweet corn on the cob Fresh whole russet potatoes Great Value Deluxe mac & cheese Great Value large white eggs Great Value brown & serve dinner rolls Betty Crocker cream cheese frosting Betty Crocker super moist carrot cake mixSource: Walmart For shoppers looking to get ahead on next year’s holiday prep, Walmart will be marking down Easter items by 50-90% starting on April 6, 2026.
